name: Moon Princess
detailed_description:
Official Communities

  • Twitter/X: @eggHatcherGame @egghatcherJPN

  • Weibo/RedNote/Heybox: @养蛋人

  • Discord: Moon Princess Official


About the Game

🌙Moon Princess is a daughter-raising game set in a world of wuxia and mythology. In Mingyue, a land where wulin heroes thrive, you play as a great hero who personally raises your young daughter into adulthood.

Over 50 career endings and 20+ relationship outcomes, all shaped by your guidance—

  • Will she train to become a legendary hero? Or fall to darkness and become an enemy of Jianghu?

  • Perhaps she’ll live a peaceful life, spend her days with music, chess, calligraphy, and painting?

  • Or pursue fame and a life of service, climbing the ranks… even…dare we say, ascending to the throne?

  • More branching endings — same endings can be achieved through different story paths depending on your choices and relationships.

  • New game features — unlock hidden content across multiple playthroughs: martial arts skills, new characters, new plotlines, and new endings...With each playthrough, more hidden truths emerge. Unresolved fates and mysteries in one lifetime may find answers in the next...

During the New Moon Era, a Blood Moon suddenly dominated the sky, staining the earth in red and plunging earth inhabitants into fear. Simultaneously, eerie disturbances emerge from deep within the Forsaken Valley, unleashing rampaging beasts and demons that brought devastation to all.

To restore peace, the great sects of the Jianghu came together to form the Three Swords Alliance. Talented heroes from across the land gathered, vowing to unravel the mystery of Forsaken Valley. Yet, unknown to them, a vast ancient conspiracy lurks beneath it all...

Amidst a turbulent Jianghu, the truth you uncover may decide the fate of Mingyue.

You'll encounter 60+ unique characters, each with their own allegiances and stories.

12 "Zodiac Descendants" — with whom your daughter can develop deep relationships that could possibly end in marriage.

This game offers 2-3 times more text volume and events than our previous one, with richer stories awaiting —

  • Meaningful Character Interactions— NPCs actively engage in your daughter’s life, from classes, duels, sect activities, and festivals, to sharing meals, tea, theater, and baths, creating precious memories together.

  • A Complex Social Network— NPCs can become friends after adventures or entangle your daughter in complicated romantic dramas.

  • A living Jianghu — This world remembers every grudge and favor. Sects rise or fall by your actions. Heroic deeds may be repaid; but vendettas could lead to deadly pursuits...

30+ explorable locations, each offering more complex mechanics —

  • Train your daughter in martial arts, study esoteric techniques, brew medicines, take disciples, and grow your sect.

  • Earn coin by street vending, appraising antiques, or by running inns and clinics, expand your Jianghu business.

  • Hunt, fish, sail, relax in hot springs, or seek thrills at theaters, The Joyous Terrace, or The Ghost Alley.

  • Embrace rural life—farm, raise animals, cook, craft, and live in peace.

  • Exploration— Discover hidden treasure chests, secret locations, and random encounters! Sneak into an immortal’s cave, stumble upon the imperial harem of 3,000…? If you can’t get the treasure by force, try picking the locks, sleuth infiltrating, or maybe have you tried poisoning the guards?

Enjoy the tranquil life of Mingyue with your daughter!

  • Sect Training— Your daughter can join one of three great sword sects, each with unique legacies shaping her growth, skills, Jianghu connections, and even the main storyline.

  • The Hundred Sects— Whether they are orthodox or forbidden, your daughter can learn from sect masters through formal training, or secretly study in the dead of night!

  • Duel Battles— Challenge randoms for fame and riches in arena battles!

  • Underground Exploration— Building on our previous turn-based combat system, this new strategy is more complex & diverse, your daughter and her teammates can trigger combo techniques together! 

  • Slay Demons and Monsters— Purge demons from Forsaken Valley, or even tame them as loyal companions!

  • Parent Life— On rest days, you can train or work, cook for your daughter, teach her martial arts, or plan outings. The game focuses more on warm family moments and unlocks different content depending on whether you play as father or mother.

  • Travel Adventures— Each year, you and your daughter go on family trips, visiting famous mountains, secret realms, encountering special events that unlock hidden stories. Every choice you make in front of her can influence her personality.

Remember, no matter how you do, you'll always be the one she treasures most!

Enjoy raising your daughter in Moon Princess!

Hi everyone!

We’re Egg Hatcher— the creators behind Volcano Princess, and we're thrilled to finally present the store page for our second daughter-raising game: Moon Princess!

To retain the unique style of our games, the main producers are still just the two of us.

Moon Princess has been in development for over a year and a half, with a significantly larger scope than our previous game. More storylines, more gameplay, more artwork—plus voice acting and multilingual support still to come. Fortunately, we’ve recruited some partners to help with production, and while ensuring quality, we are committed to bringing this game to you as soon as possible!

The themes of Wuxia mythology and moon/zodiac signs have been on our minds since 2023. We are very passionate about this topic and have read many Wuxia novels and ancient histories to create a more immersive world. We hope players will find deep bonds and emotions connecting them in this world we created.

Wishing you all a smooth journey in Jianghu and happiness every day!😊

short_description: 🌙A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10 / Windows11
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 260, ATI Radeon 4870 HD, or equivalent card with at least 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
